summary: Open Archiver is a dedicated email archiving solution equipped with full-text search and eDiscovery capabilities. It enables organisations to systematically store, index, and retrieve historical email data for compliance and investigative needs. Distributed under the AGPL-3.0 licence, the project is packaged as a containerised application.
goodFor: It is well-suited for system administrators looking to implement a self-hosted email archiving pipeline with search tools for legal or administrative review.
watchOut: The software carries a moderate maintenance profile and uses the AGPL-3.0 licence, which places copyleft requirements on network-deployed modifications.
deployNotes: Because it runs via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
